stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 ls-files [--error-unmatch] [--] [<pathspec>...]

Show information about files in the index.

This command lists files that are in the index (staged area).
Without any pathspecs, it shows all tracked files. With pathspecs,
it only shows files matching those patterns.

Options:
    --error-unmatch
        if any pathspec doesn't match, exit with error
    <pathspec>...
        files to show (default: all files)
